public_rationale: The October 16, 2019 paper documents a customized, sensor-equipped cube used for most experiments [e1]. It also reports a vision-only setup, which the October 15 announcement describes as using a cube modified only by cutting its center stickers [e1, e2]. This supports modified hardware use, but does not establish that the particular video Marcus referenced required internal sensors [e1, e2]. These technical records do not establish the extent of practical application through December 7, 2023, leaving the compound claim unresolved [e1, e2].
limitations: The evidence does not identify which demonstration video Marcus referenced.

The packet contains no adequate deployment inventory or retrospective establishing the extent of practical use of the demonstrated system or its specific methods from October 15, 2019 through December 7, 2023.
A lack of deployment evidence does not establish a lack of practical use.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI's Rubik's cube robot demo relied on a sensor-instrumented cube and had little real-world application.

statement.excerpt: Regular readers will recall how that turned out: the Rubik’s cube was instrumented with sensors, and not straight off the shelf, and what worked for the Rubik’s cube in the demo video didn’t turn out have a whole lot of application in the real world.
statement.document_title: The truth about Google’s amazing new demo

from_speaker: the Rubik’s cube was instrumented with sensors
didn’t turn out have a whole lot of application in the real world
our_interpretation: The claim concerns the 2019 demonstration and practical applications developed by the post date.
Little real-world application means limited practical use beyond research demonstrations. It does not mean no scientific influence.
The demonstrated system and its specific methods are the relevant scope; the usefulness of reinforcement learning generally would not settle this claim.
The hardware and practical-application components must both be established to support the whole claim.
criteria.support_condition: Technical records establish use of a modified, sensor-equipped cube, and subsequent records establish limited practical application of the demonstrated system or its specific methods through the post date.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records establish that the referenced demonstration used an ordinary uninstrumented cube, or document substantial practical application of the demonstrated system or its specific methods during the target period.
